text:
A compiler for specifications: it turns a set of Markdown spec files into a checked graph of
atomic specs, and reports where those specs contradict, duplicate or under-specify each other.

canonical.subject: SDD Compiler
canonical.response: turns a set of Markdown spec files into a checked graph of atomic specs, and reports where those specs contradict, duplicate or under-specify each other

Q3.quote: checked graph of atomic specs, and reports where those specs contradict, duplicate or under-specify

ambiguity.detail: a requirement with no modal verb (MUST, SHOULD, MAY …)

the judge was unsure: B describes how the SDD Compiler processes Markdown spec files (which include feature specs); A specifies how feature specs should be identified and documented. B's description of the compiler's input refines A's specification of feature spec format.
